topic: Use number bonds to add three single-digit numbers
rationaleNote: One text-led method card: the three success-criteria steps word for word and the finished 7 + 5 + 3 model (ending on 15, so the 'stop at 10' slip is answered), kept for lesson 20 (add two 2-digit numbers mentally), where bridging to the next ten leans on finding a number bond to 10 first. The reordered-counters picture was left on the slides because the wall can neither fit both rows beside the steps nor draw the board's method frame, and its numbers (4 + 2 + 6) would sit beside a different worked case; vocabulary and doubles stay on the slides.

items.label: Step 1
items.text: Find two numbers that are a {{number bond}} to 10. They might not be next to each other.
